verses: The arm of Wu was full of might; None could his fire withstand; And Ch'eng and K'ang stood forth to sight, As kinged by God's own hand. We err not when we call then sage. How grandly they maintained Their hold of all the heritage That Wen and Wu had gained! As here we worship, they descend, While bells and drums resound, And stones and lutes their music blend. With blessings we are crowned. The rites correctly we discharge; The feast we freely share. Those sires Chou's glory will enlarge, And ever for it care.
